text.en:
Subject to the terns and conditions presented in section fifteen of Act Numbered Thirty-six
hundred and thirty-Six, as amended-by "Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and-thirty-two, and to
the provisions of the Constitution, Roman Baluyut is authorized to sell, lease, convey, grant, assign, or
otherwise transfer his franchise and all property and rights acquired under Act Numbered Thirty-eight
hundred and eighty, in favor of the Riverside Electric Company, In-corporated, a domestic corporation duly
organized and existing under and by virtue of the. laws of the Philippines.

It is expressly provided that in the event the government should desire to maintain and operate
for itself the plant and the enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender,its franchise and will turn
over to the government all-serviceable equipments, at cost.

This Act shall take effect en its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, June 18, 1939.
